summary: Traced untrusted IndexedDB hand values: hand-store.ts trendData() -> parseHandRecord (stake.bigBet must be a safe integer >= 1 via isWhole; invalid values are skipped) -> trendHand -> bb100Value, which is the only caller path (trends.ts:309 per-500 groups, :396 Session/Day groups). Recursion: the recursive gcd is replaced by an iterative Euclid loop, which takes O(log bigBet) steps for positive safe integers, so a crafted store can no longer overflow the stack. Overflow and NaN: the LCM is capped at MAX_SAFE_INTEGER before it is used. Above the cap, floatBb100 sums net/bigBet, which is finite because net comes from safe-integer amounts and bigBet >= 1. On the exact path, lcm*n and 2000*|result| stay finite (each term is at most about 2^106). The result therefore cannot be Infinity or NaN, so the chart geometry gets finite values. Slow loops: each group costs O(n) with no BigInt, and the early return happens on the first unsafe LCM. gcd would not terminate for a NaN or Infinity bigBet, but parseHandRecord rejects those values before they reach it, so there is no reachable path and no finding. The type change from a cast to a discriminated union removes an unchecked cast and has no runtime effect. No new dependencies, secrets, logging, injection surface or randomness.
